title: CreateAssistantConversationRequest
description: Request body of POST /api/assistant-conversations (HEL-663). Both fields are optional. `firstMessage`, when supplied, seeds the conversation's initial transcript and (absent an explicit `title`) drives title derivation from its first text block, truncated. When BOTH fields are absent, `title` defaults server-side to the literal "New conversation" (design.md D6) -- never rejected, never left unset.

title.description: Explicit title, wins outright over any derivation from firstMessage when present.

firstMessage.description: A single Claude tool-message turn (role + content blocks) that seeds the conversation's transcript, shaped like ClaudeToolMessage (com.helio.ai): { role: string, content: [{ blockType: 'text'|'tool_use'|'tool_result', ... } ] }. Opaque to this schema (server-validated); absent when the conversation starts with no seed message.
